claims.hypothesis: Do CO isotopologues constrain the depth of the gas gap between the two dust rings in HD 100546
claims.experiment: Varied the gas depletion delta_gas_gap from 1 to 1e-5 in DALI and compared CO isotopologue profiles with ALMA data
claims.result: Models with deeper gaps underpredict CO isotopologue emission in the gap
claims.finding: The disk has a shallow gas gap, depleted by at most a factor of ~10

evidence.quote: In particular, the CO isotopologue emission is consistent with a shallow gas gap with no more than a factor of $\sim 10$ drop in gas density at $40-175$ au.

claims.hypothesis: Under what conditions are molecular rings co-spatial with dust rings
claims.experiment: Gas gap depth, C/O, background UV and flaring were varied in DALI and ring locations compared across HCN, CN, C2H and NO
claims.result: Rings coincide with dust rings only for very deep gaps or a radially varying C/O
claims.finding: Molecular rings need not trace gas gaps and can be chemical rather than physical

evidence.quote: the molecular emission rings are only co-spatial with the dust rings if the gas gap between the dust rings is depleted by at least four orders of magnitude in gas
or if the C/O ratio of the gas is varying as a function of radius.

claims.hypothesis: Are the UV tracers CN, C2H and NO good tracers of gas gap depth
claims.experiment: Computed column densities and line ratios for different gap depths
claims.result: Their column densities are insensitive to gap depth within a factor of a few for shallow to moderately deep gaps
claims.finding: CN, C2H and NO are not good tracers of the gas gap depth

evidence.quote: Therefore, the CN, , and NO radicals are not good tracers of the gas gap depth.

claims.hypothesis: Does a lower external UV field improve the match in the outer disk

claims.finding: A reduced background UV field is needed to suppress the outer rings

evidence.quote: Reducing the background UV field by a factor of 10 removes the extended emission and outer ring seen in CN and , respectively, and reduces the ring seen in NO at 300 au.

claims.hypothesis: Can a radially varying C/O explain the double rings seen in HD 100546
